lines.text: According to the Snowpriestess's notes, the cave was her first resting place.
Things might get dangerous inside. Stay close and don't stray too far from me while exploring the cave.
Accidents have a habit of taking place in unexplored places.
So you should also stay alert to protect yourself.
Well, I'll also do my best to keep you safe.

options: What if I lose track of you by accident?

r: What if I lose track of you by accident?

lines.text: "Cross mount and stream, snows thus traversed; fate's choice fixed in stone."
This is probably the choice she made at that time.
This vantage point lets you see the entire valley.
Imagine her coming here for the first time and seeing the entire place. She must be filled with hope.
The forest cabin, the shrines ... and even the Protective Array... Everything has been left behind.
Everything except for the Snowpriestess whose fate remains a mystery.
She left almost everything she had, except for herself.
Endmin, this has been a great adventure ... with you.

options: Light has returned to her cabin, at least.
At least her research has been read by you and me.

r: Light has returned to her cabin, at least.
At least her research has been read by you and me.
